{{Top}}
{{Quote|Sweep every centimeter. If you find any hostiles&mdash;take them ''alive!''<nowiki></nowiki>|A [[Toma]] [[Security guard/Legends|security guard]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
A '''centimeter''' was a unit of measurement.

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] boasted fifteen-centimeter-thick [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Hull/Legends|hulls]].<ref name="CCG-Driver">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=AT-AT Driver}}</ref>
